name: Petstore — REST basics
description: CRUD endpoints showing URL, path-template, query, header and JSON body matching, priorities and status codes.

name: Dynamic responses — templating
description: Responses built from the request with Handlebars: echo path, query, headers and JSON body, random data, dates and conditionals.

name: Shopping cart — stateful scenarios
description: A cart that changes state across calls using WireMock scenarios: empty → item added → checked out.

name: Resilience testing — faults & delays
description: Slow responses, random latency, dropped connections, malformed responses, 429/503 with Retry-After. Test your timeouts and retries.

name: Calculator — SOAP from WSDL
description: Generated from a WSDL: one stub per operation, the ?wsdl endpoint and a fault for unknown operations. Plus a hand-written stub matching on XPath values.
